tools.name: search_yachts
tools.description: Find charter yachts matching the client's brief. All fields are optional; pass what the client has told you. Returns up to a handful of boats with indicative weekly prices. The first search is free; further searches need a verified email (4 per day) or phone (10 per day).

tools.name: yacht_details
tools.description: Full details for one yacht from a previous search: more photos, description, highlights and toys.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check live availability of one yacht for a date range. Requires a verified phone number.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description: Send a 6-digit code to the client's email address. Verifying an email raises the daily search limit to 4.

tools.name: confirm_email
tools.description: Confirm the email code the client received.

tools.name: verify_phone
tools.description: Send a code by text message to the client's phone. Requires a verified email first. Raises the daily search limit to 10 and enables live availability.

tools.name: confirm_phone
tools.description: Confirm the code the client received by text message.

tools.name: request_proposal
tools.description: Ask a DMA broker to prepare a proposal for the chosen yachts. The broker follows up by email. Requires a verified email.

tools.name: delete_my_data
tools.description: Erase everything stored about the client. Only call when the client explicitly asks, with confirm set to true.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_yachts, verify_email, verify_phone · Public sink: search_yachts, verify_email, confirm_email, verify_phone, request_proposal · Destructive: delete_my_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_yachts, verify_email, verify_phone · Public sink: search_yachts, verify_email, confirm_email, verify_phone, request_proposal · Destructive: delete_my_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
